page.overview:
Who is Ka-Hor?

Ka-Hor is a minor antagonist in Invincible, debuting in Season 1. He is an ancient undead Egyptian who was cursed and imprisoned by his own people within his tomb. Only by possessing a host and taking control of their body would Ka-Hor be able to escape his imprisonment.

Throughout the first three seasons of the series, Ka-Hor made several attempts to escape his tomb, only to fail every time thanks to some inadvertent circumstance. In most cases, this was due to his tomb being repeatedly sealed off before he could leave, or because of his initial refusal to possess a female host. His attempts at escape were also aided by cult-like worshipers who sought to revive Ka-Hor.

Eventually, after his latest attempt to possess Invincible had once again inadvertently failed, Ka-Hor grew tired of waiting and opted to possess one woman named Riley, despite her being female. Taking control of her body, Ka-Hor was finally able to escape his imprisonment.

Ka-Hor takes the form of a cursed and undead mummy. He has the dried and emaciated body while being wrapped in glowing green bandages that extend outward and act like tendrils. His eyes glow red from within a sunken face.
